title: Structured provenance and passage integrity
assessed: Exact submitted signed JSON artifacts and COPY/COMPOSE transitions under admitted authority certificates or exact GitHub repository controller grants observed over HTTPS. Repository control authorizes only attestations about the named repository objects, not external truth, institutional authority or execution permission.
not_assessed: Authenticity of an external locator beyond the admitted signer's attestation
Completeness of evidence outside the submitted graph
Execution or behavior of a submitted external workflow
Legal compliance, safety or universal truth
Continuity of versions outside the submitted graph
Independent cryptographic proof of historical GitHub state; namespace observations are signed HTTPS observations by the assessor.
review_triggers: Source or authority withdrawal, correction, dispute or expiry
failure_outcome: Signed assessment record; no Standing Mark
payment_policy: Payment purchases an evaluation, never a favorable result. Identical purchase recovery does not create a new payment authorization.

namespace_admission.grant_binding: Exact key, role, signed payload hashes, namespace scope, operations and validity. No wildcard source or transition grant.
namespace_admission.current_status: An ACTIVE registry snapshot requires fresh observations of the exact submitted manifest hashes. Changed, withdrawn, expired or inaccessible manifests limit current standing; issuance-time evidence remains immutable.
namespace_admission.source_locator: Within the same canonical repository namespace.
namespace_admission.issuer_scope: github-repository:* authorizes assessment under this profile only.
